section.title: Getting Ready for Unit 9
section.para: To be ready for this unit, you need to be able to:

list.item: Use vertex form to name the transformations made to \(y=x^2\).

section.para: Next, you will answer some questions that will help you see how ready you are for this unit. If you need help, some mini-lessons will help you brush up on anything you need to work on.
